subject.title: [Feature]: Inject parent channel pinned messages into Discord thread session context

question: Should Discord thread sessions inherit parent-channel pinned messages automatically, and should that be default-on, opt-in config, or metadata-only?
rationale: The code can reach parent metadata and manually read pins, but choosing the default and visibility model changes what parent-channel content becomes model-visible in thread sessions.

options.title: Opt-in inherited pin context
options.body: Add an explicit Discord setting for parent-pin inheritance and gate fetched pins through the existing read-target and supplemental-context visibility rules.

options.title: Default-on inherited pin context
options.body: Fetch and inject parent pins for all Discord thread sessions, accepting the broader default context exposure as the product contract.

options.title: Metadata-only parent hint
options.body: Expose parent channel metadata clearly but leave pin reads as an explicit tool action rather than automatic context.

recommendation.title: Opt-in inherited pin context
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Discord setting for parent-pin inheritance and gate fetched pins through the existing read-target and supplemental-context visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Discord context and thread-starter visibility path that would carry this behavior.
